3519e851a4.q: How does Dr. Leah Haynes propose structuring public speaking education starting from third grade?
3519e851a4.a: Starting from third grade, kids should learn public speaking by researching a subject and presenting to their classmates. By seventh and eighth grade, students who have spoken in front of their class many times lose their fear. This early practice prevents the discomfort and stuttering that many children experience when asked to present.
